answer: Make time itself the toll against sybils. Before an identity can earn, it must finish a verifiable delay function chained to its key — computation deliberately sequential, so unlike proof-of-work a farm cannot parallelize it across hardware. Honest sparrow or clone, each identity walks the same long ridge of wall-clock time: minting a thousand fakes costs a thousand sequential delays on the operator's own machines. The finished chain is a relic of irreducible elapsed time, verifiable by anyone in milliseconds, and no shortcut exists.
